reviews.text: I stopped in looking for food for my new puppy and ended up getting some really helpful advice from one of the staff members. They explained the differences between a few brands and even suggested some treats that my puppy absolutely loves!! ☺️

It's a great place to find any of your pet supply needs! Super clean and modern dog wash stations. Denisse was a great help in pointing out where things I needed were and very friendly. Definitely will come again!
Great place jad everything we need!

This is my GoTo place for my furry angels. It is not just for the quality of the items they carry but I really feel welcomed. Camber's customer service is A++. She is so helpful and patient w/the many questions I sometimes come up with. Thank you Camber!
My experience with Camber was excellent. I felt taken care of and she was very knowledgeable. I am telling all my friends in Phoenix AZ
Staff is always super friendly, their self dog wash is always clean and ready
Thanks for the great review Robert! We're so glad you had such a good experience at the store!

***UPDATE 11/14/2025***
I stopped in yesterday to pick up some treats for my Ridgeback, Blue, who struggles with allergies and sensitive skin. Johnathan was incredibly knowledgeable and helpful. He listened to my concerns, respected my budget, and recommended great products — even giving us samples to try first.

He also took the time to educate me about the store’s dog bathing station after I mentioned how much I dislike using my shower at home. That information alone was so helpful! Johnathan was patient, friendly, and gave Blue plenty of attention, which absolutely made my pup’s day.

I always have great experiences at this store, and this visit was no exception. I truly appreciate Johnathan’s guidance and can’t wait to try his suggestions to help Blue’s coat improve. Highly recommend!

I went in this evening with my kiddo and Ridgeback. I was looking for healthy treats for him and Ducky, who was working, was kind enough to share with me a healthy choice that she currently gives her large breed dog. I shared with her my concern was weight control and she explained to me why the treats she likes are healthy. On the plus side she priced matched the item! Ducky also treated my dog with kindness and gave him a couple of treats. That made his day! Ducky made it very easy to get what I needed, I had an understanding why the treats were good and it was affordable. I will definitely be back. Ducky was very sweet, kind and knowledgeable.
